document.title: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
document.summary: AGENTS.md becomes a VitaDeck-specific runbook, the third-party skill suite and its setup docs leave the repo, the five kept skills get corrected, comprehende and a repo-owned pages skill with its publish script and prune workflow join the PR workflow, the JS workspace gets an oxfmt pass, and the Vita Docker image is repaired.
document.why: The Matt Pocock skill suite is [no longer in use](source:s1), and AGENTS.md only pointed at it.

sources.label: PR #38
sources.title: chore: rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
sources.gist: Rewrite AGENTS.md around VitaDeck, drop the unused mattpocock skills, fix the kept skills, and format the JS workspace.

sources.label: chatgpt-codex-connector on PR #38
sources.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
sources.body: Qualify when CMake stages example packages. On a fresh host build, `cmake --build out` only copies the runtime; examples are staged by the separate `stage_examples` target (also a dependency of `run`). Clarify that staging requires `stage_examples` or `run`.

sources.label: chatgpt-codex-connector on PR #38
sources.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
sources.body: List JavaScript checks as separate pnpm commands. If an agent copies `pnpm --dir js tsc | lint | format:check | build` literally, the shell treats `|` as pipeline operators.

sources.label: cursor on PR #38
sources.author: cursor
sources.body: Risk: low. Not approved: Cursor Bugbot completed with no findings and Security Agent was not running, but the Vita VPK CI check failed, so this does not meet the passing-CI approval rule.

sources.label: Address Codex review: staging target and separate pnpm commands
Build vitaShaRK from source and pin vitaGL in the Vita image

lookFor: The [PR description](source:s1) says `skills-lock.json` is removed. At head it is modified: it lists only `comprehende` from `matemolnar8/comprehende`; `pages` is no longer tracked by the `skills` CLI.
The [PR description](source:s1) does not say that the Dockerfile change is unrelated feature-wise to the AGENTS.md rewrite; it is here because the PR's own CI was red.

The [Vita VPK check failed](source:s4) on this branch and on `main` at 1f305ea for the vitaGL/vitaShaRK mismatch; the Vita image fix part addresses it. Confirm the `vpk` job is green at head before merging.
Manual step: the hosted review URL returns 404 until GitHub Pages is enabled on the repo (Settings, Pages, Deploy from a branch, `gh-pages`, `/`).

groups.title: AGENTS.md rewrite
groups.why: The old file was a generic command list plus pointers to the removed skills. The [PR](source:s1) replaces it with how VitaDeck works, where code lives, footguns, surfaces to check, and verification tiers.
groups.summary: AGENTS.md is one rewritten file; its Pull requests section now asks for the comprehende review that the Comprehende PR workflow part installs.
lookFor: The How it works paragraph now says a plain `cmake --build out` copies the runtime only and that `stage_examples` (or `run`) stages the examples, resolving [the Codex comment](source:s2).
The Individual commands line lists `pnpm --dir js tsc`, `lint`, `format:check`, and `build` as four full commands instead of a `|`-joined shorthand, resolving [the Codex comment](source:s3).
The Footguns section claims `js/examples/chat/src/genesys/genesys.local.ts` is gitignored and holds credentials. Check `.gitignore` before trusting the never-commit rule.

groups.title: Corrections to the five kept skills
groups.why: Each kept skill was checked against CMakeLists, scripts, `src/`, and the SDK CLI; the [PR](source:s1) lists the stale claims found.
groups.summary: Four SKILL.md files change a few lines each so their commands and claims match the code at head.
lookFor: Subtle: `vitadeck-manual-testing` replaces copying one `chat.vdapp` with `cmake --build out --target stage_examples`, which copies every example that has a `dist/*.vdapp` and exits 1 when none is built. `active-package.txt` is still written by hand.
`vitadeck-manual-testing` drops the claim that the on-device upload URL can omit the port; `src/upload/http_server.c` formats the URL with the bound port.

groups.title: Delete the third-party skills and their setup docs
groups.why: The [PR](source:s1) removes the mattpocock suite and `frontend-design`; `docs/agents/` and `skills-lock.json` entries existed only for those skills.
groups.summary: Every file here is a whole-file deletion of imported skill text, plus `skills-lock.json` losing their entries; nothing in the repo referenced them after the AGENTS.md rewrite.

groups.title: domain.md deleted in both copies
groups.why: `docs/agents/domain.md` was a copy the setup skill wrote from its own `domain.md`; both go.
groups.summary: The same deletion twice; read neither.

groups.title: triage-labels.md deleted in both copies
groups.why: `docs/agents/triage-labels.md` was a copy the setup skill wrote from its own `triage-labels.md`; the labels it mapped never existed on the GitHub repo.
groups.summary: The same deletion twice; read neither.

groups.title: Install comprehende, add a self-contained pages skill, wire both into the PR workflow
groups.why: Máté asked for comprehende reviews hosted on GitHub Pages as part of every PR; this is the installed skill text and the lock entries that `skills` manages.
groups.summary: `.agents/skills/comprehende/` is the upstream skill copied verbatim by `npx skills add` and recorded in `skills-lock.json`; `.agents/skills/pages/` is a repo-owned skill whose `scripts/pages-review.ts` publishes a folder onto this repo's `gh-pages` branch, `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs its `prune` on PR close and daily, and AGENTS.md's Pull requests section calls the two skills.
lookFor: `pages-review.ts` is 728 lines of new TypeScript with no dependencies: it runs `git worktree add` on a temp dir for `gh-pages`, copies the site under `pr/<n>/` or `site/<slug>/`, writes `published.json` and a root `index.html`, commits, and pushes with up to five fetch-reset retries. Nothing in this repo typechecks or lints it; it runs with `node --experimental-strip-types`.

Subtle: `ensureGitIdentity` sets `user.name`/`user.email` on the work tree when they are unset, and the worktree gets `commit.gpgsign false`. Commits on `gh-pages` are unsigned even when the main checkout signs.

`pages-reviews.yml` checks out the default branch, so it only works once this PR merges; until then a closed PR keeps its `pr/<n>/` folder. It needs no install step because the script has no dependencies.

groups.title: oxfmt line wrapping
groups.why: `pnpm --dir js format:check` failed on `main`; the [PR](source:s1) runs the formatter in its own commit.
groups.summary: Every hunk rejoins parameter lists, call arguments, JSX props, or a union type onto one line under oxfmt's print width, and `js/packages/sdk/README.md` loses a trailing blank line.

groups.title: Import line reformats
groups.why: oxfmt touched one import line in each of these files.
groups.summary: One-line import reformats with no symbol change; skip them.

groups.title: Vita image: build vitaShaRK from source, pin vitaGL
groups.why: The Vita VPK job [failed on this branch](source:s4) and on `main`: vitaGL master calls `shark_set_shader_association_path`, which the vdpm vitaShaRK in `gnuton/vitasdk-docker` predates. [The commit](source:s6) installs vitaShaRK from source first.
groups.summary: The Dockerfile clones vitaShaRK at df24065 and runs `make install` into `$VITASDK` before vitaGL, and vitaGL moves from `--depth=1` master to a checkout of 76f43e6.
lookFor: Breaking: `--depth=1` is gone from both clones, so the image build fetches full history for vitaShaRK and vitaGL. Slower first build; the layers cache afterwards.
The CMake link list already names `vitashark`, so the newer `libvitashark.a` replaces the vdpm one at the same path; `cmake --build out-vita` produced `vitadeck.vpk` locally against this image.

commits.subject: Build vitaShaRK from source and pin vitaGL in the Vita image
commits.author: matemolnar8
commits.body:
vitaGL master now calls shark_set_shader_association_path, which the vdpm
vitaShaRK inside gnuton/vitasdk-docker predates, so the image build failed.
Install vitaShaRK from its pinned source first and pin vitaGL to a commit
instead of tracking master.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Prune gh-pages reviews on PR close and daily
commits.author: matemolnar8

commits.subject: Make the pages skill self-contained
commits.author: matemolnar8
commits.body:
Copy the gh-pages publish script into the skill with its git helper inlined,
run it with node's type stripping, and drop pages from skills-lock.json so
skills update does not overwrite it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Address Codex review: staging target and separate pnpm commands
commits.author: matemolnar8

commits.subject: Add comprehende and pages skills to the PR workflow
commits.author: matemolnar8
commits.body:
Install both from matemolnar8/comprehende with the skills CLI. The pages
skill is adapted to run the publish script from a comprehende checkout with
--repo pointing at this work tree. AGENTS.md now asks for a hosted comprehende
review URL in every PR body.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Rewrite AGENTS.md and keep only VitaDeck skills
commits.author: matemolnar8
commits.body:
Drop the mattpocock and anthropics third-party skills, skills-lock.json, and
the docs/agents setup files that only those skills consumed. Rewrite AGENTS.md
around how VitaDeck works, where code lives, footguns, and verification tiers.
Fix stale claims in the remaining vitadeck-* skills: macOS configure line,
stage_examples target, Cursor-only tmux path, upload port fallback, scaffold
config fields, and the skill script path.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
